newsitem.title: GREECE: GENER TO GO AHEAD WITH BONUS SHARE ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: GENER TO GO AHEAD WITH BONUS SHARE ISSUE.

text.p: Small-cap construction listing Gener got shareholder approval to proceed with a bonus share issue resulting from a capitalisation of 255 million drachmas of reserves, it said in a statement.

The company will issue 690,000 bonus shares with a par value of 370 drachmas. Shareholders will be entitled to one bonus share for every 10 shares outstanding. This will bring its total outstanding shares to 7.59 million.
Gener is also eyeing a convertible bond issue and will present the plan to the upcoming shareholders meeting on February 21, it said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
